Subject: Request: 30m CIO + VP micro-brief for Skyrift demo

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time last week. For the demo next week we typically request a short 30-minute CIO/VP micro-brief so we can align on business priorities and make the hour-long session with engineering as productive as possible. Two quick asks: 1) can the CIO and one VP-level sponsor attend this 30-minute pre-brief, and 2) if timing is tight, would an evening slot (PDT) work?

Proposed 30-minute windows (all PDT):
- Wed Jun 9, 5:00–5:30 PM
- Thu Jun 10, 5:30–6:00 PM
- Fri Jun 11, 4:00–4:30 PM

If none of those work, please suggest two alternatives and indicate who (CIO or VP) will join so we can tailor the agenda. I attached a very short agenda and a one-page mutual action plan for context.

Quick note: we plan to record the demo for internal follow-ups; let me know if that’s a problem.

Best,
David
